rationale: The revised plan adequately addresses the reviewer feedback and stays appropriately scoped to the reported issue. It now explicitly inspects how `x_vars`, `y_vars`, and `diag_vars` are formed and preserved before `map_diag`, avoids prematurely prescribing `.loc[:, var]`, proposes an exact-label helper grounded in pandas MultiIndex semantics, and adds the requested classification pass over single-column lookups so only true exact-column accesses are changed. It also expands inspection to dropna/mask paths, strengthens the regression test beyond “does not raise,” and implicitly keeps the patch minimal by limiting changes to confirmed exact-label bugs rather than broad variable-inference normalization. As a plan, this is specific, actionable, and aligned with the fail-to-pass and regression-risk constraints.
